instruction: Candid documentary medium shot in an indoor gym with a brick wall. The man in the grey t-shirt (R1) kneels on a blue mat on the right, holding his right fist up in a demonstration pose while looking intently at the woman. In the foreground left, the woman in the blue jacket (R2) is seen from behind, watching him. Soft side lighting illuminates the scene, highlighting the textures of the brick wall.
